results.notes: All 5 advertised entity sets resolved through the sensorthings provider with the seeded counts {'Thing': 1, 'Sensor': 1, 'ObservedProperty': 1, 'Datastream': 1, 'Observation': 48}. Not advertised by this server, so not exercised: ['FeaturesOfInterest', 'HistoricalLocations', 'Locations'].

expandTo='Datastream' on Observation added ['Datastream_description', 'Datastream_id', 'Datastream_name', 'Datastream_observationType', 'Datastream_phenomenonTimeEnd', 'Datastream_phenomenonTimeStart', 'Datastream_properties', 'Datastream_resultTimeEnd', 'Datastream_resultTimeStart', 'Datastream_selfLink', 'Datastream_unitOfMeasurement'] to the schema, so the child entity is traversed rather than the expansion being silently dropped.

Recorded against honua-server#4200, which described a paging/count defect: it does not reproduce on this build.
